_what: Cloudflare Web Analytics. Put the site token from the dashboard in "token" and the beacon goes on every page. Empty means no beacon and no third-party script at all.
_why_this_is_not_a_secret: A Web Analytics site token is public by design - it is read straight out of the page source by anyone who views it. It grants no access to the account.
_where: Cloudflare dashboard > Analytics & Logs > Web Analytics > theplatbook.com > Manage site > the JS snippet, the value of "token".
